label: Manila
short_description: The Manila Bay waterfront and Ortigas business district to the Newport City airport complex.
intro: Manila's hotels in this directory are spread across Metro Manila's distinct centers rather than a single downtown: the Manila Bay waterfront in Malate, known for its sunset views and proximity to the cultural district; the Ortigas Center business hub straddling Mandaluyong and Pasig; and Newport City in Pasay, an integrated resort complex directly across from Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA). Traffic makes proximity to your actual destination -- airport, convention center or business district -- the main practical factor in choosing a base.
